The company shows moderate leverage (total liabilities are ~74% of total assets) and weak near-term liquidity (current ratio 0.91), which constrains credit quality. However, profitability appears solid with EBIT of ~13.8% of revenue, and shareholders’ equity is sizable relative to assets, providing some balance-sheet support. Overall, these factors point to a speculative investment-grade credit profile.  

DECISION: BBB-
